segments.ja533:1.3: Gaccha tuvampi mā kaṅkhi, natthi baddhe [bandhe (syā. ka.)] sahāyatā”.
segments.ja533:2.1: “Gacche vāhaṃ na vā gacche, na tena amaro siyaṃ;
segments.ja533:2.3: Sukhitaṃ taṃ upāsitvā, dukkhitaṃ taṃ kathaṃ jahe.
segments.ja533:3.1: “Maraṇaṃ vā tayā saddhiṃ, jīvitaṃ vā tayā vinā;
segments.ja533:3.3: Tadeva maraṇaṃ seyyo, yañce jīve tayā vinā.
segments.ja533:4.1: “Nesa dhammo mahārāja, yaṃ taṃ evaṃ gataṃ jahe;
segments.ja533:4.3: Yā gati tuyhaṃ sā mayhaṃ, ruccate vihagādhipa.
segments.ja533:5.1: “Kā nu pāsena baddhassa [bandhassa (syā. ka.)], gati aññā mahānasā;
segments.ja533:5.3: Sā kathaṃ cetayānassa, muttassa tava ruccati.
segments.ja533:6.1: “Kaṃ vā tvaṃ passase atthaṃ, mama tuyhañca pakkhima;
segments.ja533:7.1: “Yaṃ na kañcanadepiñcha [depiccha (sī. pī.), dvepiccha (syā.)], andhena tamasā gataṃ;
segments.ja533:8.1: “Kathaṃ nu patataṃ seṭṭha, dhamme atthaṃ na bujjhasi [bujjhase (sī.)];
segments.ja533:8.3: Dhammo apacito santo, atthaṃ dasseti pāṇinaṃ.
segments.ja533:10.1: “Addhā eso sataṃ dhammo, yo mitto mittamāpade;
segments.ja533:11.1: “Svāyaṃ dhammo ca te ciṇṇo, bhatti ca viditā mayi;
segments.ja533:12.1: “Api tvevaṃ gate kāle, yaṃ khaṇḍaṃ [baddhaṃ (sī.), bandhaṃ (pī.)] ñātinaṃ mayā;
segments.ja533:12.3: Tayā taṃ buddhisampannaṃ [buddhisampanna (sī. syā. pī.)], assa paramasaṃvutaṃ.
segments.ja533:14.3: Tuṇhīmāsittha ubhayo, na sañcalesumāsanā [na ca sañcesu’ māsanā (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja533:16.3: Paccakamittha [paccakampittha (sī. syā. pī.)] nesādo, baddhā iti vicintayaṃ.
segments.ja533:19.1: “Yaṃ nu pāsena mahatā, baddho na kurute disaṃ;
segments.ja533:19.3: Atha kasmā abaddho tvaṃ, balī pakkhi na gacchasi.
segments.ja533:20.1: “Kinnu tyāyaṃ [tā’ yaṃ (sī. pī. ka.)] dijo hoti, mutto baddhaṃ upāsasi;
segments.ja533:20.3: Ohāya sakuṇā yanti, kiṃ eko avahīyasi”.
segments.ja533:21.1: “Rājā me so dijāmitta, sakhā pāṇasamo ca me;
segments.ja533:21.3: Neva naṃ vijahissāmi, yāva kālassa pariyāyaṃ.
segments.ja533:23.3: Atha jālañca pāsañca, āsajjāpi na bujjhati.
segments.ja533:24.1: “Api tveva mahāpañña, pāsā bahuvidhā tatā [tatā (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja533:25.1: “Api nāyaṃ tayā saddhiṃ, saṃvāsassa [sambhāsassa (sī. pī.)] sukhudrayo;
segments.ja533:25.3: Api no anumaññāsi, api no jīvitaṃ dade”.
segments.ja533:26.1: “Na ceva me tvaṃ baddhosi, napi icchāmi te vadhaṃ;
segments.ja533:26.3: Kāmaṃ khippamito gantvā, jīva tvaṃ anigho ciraṃ”.
segments.ja533:27.3: Sace ekena tuṭṭhosi, muñcetaṃ mañca bhakkhaya.
segments.ja533:28.3: Na te lābhena jīvatthi [jīnatthi (sī. syā. pī.)], etena niminā tuvaṃ.
segments.ja533:29.1: “Tadiṅgha samapekkhassu [samavekkhasu (sī. pī.)], hotu giddhi tavamhasu [tavasmasu (sī. syā.)];
segments.ja533:29.3: Maṃ pubbe bandha pāsena, pacchā muñca dijādhipaṃ.
segments.ja533:30.1: “Tāvadeva ca te lābho, katāssa [katassā (sī. pī.)] yācanāya ca;
segments.ja533:30.3: Mitti ca dhataraṭṭhehi, yāvajīvāya te siyā”.
segments.ja533:31.1: “Passantu no mahāsaṅghā, tayā muttaṃ ito gataṃ;
segments.ja533:31.3: Mittāmaccā ca bhaccā ca, puttadārā ca bandhavā.
segments.ja533:32.1: “Na ca te tādisā mittā, bahūnaṃ [bahunnaṃ (sī. pī.)] idha vijjati;
segments.ja533:33.1: “So te sahāyaṃ muñcāmi, hotu rājā tavānugo;
segments.ja533:36.3: Lābhaṃ tavāyaṃ [yathāyaṃ (sī. pī.)] dhataraṭṭho, pāpaṃ kiñci [kañci (sī.)] na dakkhati.
segments.ja533:37.1: “Khippamantepuraṃ netvā [gantvā (syā. ka.)], rañño dassehi no ubho;
segments.ja533:39.3: Patīto sumano vitto [citto (ka.)], bahuṃ dassati te dhanaṃ”.
segments.ja533:42.1: “Kathaṃ panime vihaṅgā [vihagā (sī. pī.)], tava hatthattamāgatā [hatthattha’ māgatā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja533:42.3: Kathaṃ luddo mahantānaṃ, issare idha ajjhagā”.
segments.ja533:45.3: Bhatturatthe parakkanto, dhammayutto [dhamme yutto (sī. pī.)] vihaṅgamo.
segments.ja533:47.3: Tato naṃ pāmuciṃ [pāmuñciṃ (pī. ka.)] pāsā, anuññāsiṃ sukhena ca.
segments.ja533:50.3: Lābhaṃ tavāyaṃ dhataraṭṭho, pāpaṃ kiñci na dakkhati.
segments.ja533:53.3: Patīto sumano vitto, bahuṃ dassati te dhanaṃ’.
segments.ja533:54.3: Ettheva hi ime āsuṃ [assu (sī. syā. pī.)], ubho anumatā mayā.
segments.ja533:59.3: Atho raṭṭhamidaṃ phītaṃ, dhammena manusāsahaṃ”[manusissati (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja533:60.1: “Kacci bhoto amaccesu, doso koci na vijjati;
segments.ja533:60.3: Kacci ca [kaccinnu (sī. pī.)] te tavatthesu, nāvakaṅkhanti jīvitaṃ”.
segments.ja533:61.1: “Athopi me amaccesu, doso koci na vijjati;
segments.ja533:61.3: Athopi te [athopime (sī. pī.)] mamatthesu, nāvakaṅkhanti jīvitaṃ”.
segments.ja533:64.1: “Bhavantaṃ [bhavaṃ tu (sī. pī.), bhavannu (syā.)] kacci nu mahā-sattuhatthattataṃ [hatthatthataṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] gato;
segments.ja533:65.3: Evametesaṃ jammānaṃ, pātikaṃ [pākatikaṃ (sī. pī.)] bhavati tāvade”.
segments.ja533:66.3: Na cāyaṃ kiñci rasmāsu, sattūva samapajjatha.
segments.ja533:68.3: Tato maṃ pāmucī pāsā, anuññāsi sukhena ca.
segments.ja533:70.3: Eso cāpi bahuṃ vittaṃ, labhataṃ yāvadicchati”[yāvaticchati (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja533:72.3: Sabbatthissariyaṃ tava [sabbatthissariyaṃ bhavataṃ (sī. syā. pī.), sabbissariyaṃ bhavataṃ (syā. ka.)], taṃ pasāsa [pasāsatha (sī. syā. pī.)] yadicchatha.
segments.ja533:73.3: Etaṃ dadāmi vo vittaṃ, issariyaṃ [isseraṃ (sī.), issaraṃ (pī.)] vissajāmi vo”.
segments.ja533:75.3: Paṭivattuṃ na sakkomi, na me so vinayo siyā.
segments.ja533:78.3: Na heva akatattassa, nayo etādiso siyā.
segments.ja533:79.3: Yāvatatthi mayā diṭṭhā, nāññaṃ passāmi edisaṃ.
segments.ja533:80.3: Eso cāpi mamacchando, ciraṃ passeyya vo ubho”.
segments.ja533:81.1: “Yaṃ kiccaṃ [yaṃkiñci (pī.)] parame mitte, katamasmāsu [rasmāsu (sī. pī.)] taṃ tayā;
segments.ja533:81.3: Pattā nissaṃsayaṃ tyāmhā [tyamhā (pī.)], bhattirasmāsu yā tava.
segments.ja533:82.3: Adassanena asmākaṃ [amhākaṃ (sī. pī.)], dukkhaṃ bahūsu pakkhisu.
segments.ja533:83.3: Taṃ padakkhiṇato katvā, ñātiṃ [ñātī (sī. syā. pī.)] passemurindama [passemarindama (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja533:84.3: Eso cāpi mahā attho, ñātivissāsanā siyā”.
segments.ja533:87.3: Samantā parikiriṃsu [parikariṃsu (sī. syā. pī.)], aṇḍajā laddhapaccayā”.
